get.summary: Whether the API can reach its database and object storage.
The token every state-changing request must send in the X-CSRF-TOKEN header.

post.summary: Signs a member in with email and password and starts their session.

get.summary: Who is signed in, and their Organization.
The Stills made for the Project, newest first, rejected and failed ones included.
One Still and the state it is in.

post.summary: Records that the member accepts a Still that is ready for review, in the member's name. A Clip that was confirmed with it is then queued, to be made from it. Answers 409 with the reason for a Still in any other state.

Rejects a Still that has been made and queues another of the same picture in its place. This is a new paid generation, made only for the amount the member confirms, and it counts against the Project's ceiling. The rejected Still is kept, with what it cost. Answers 409 with the reason for a Still that has not been made, when the confirmed amount is not what another is estimated at now, when a Clip has been made from it, or when it would take the Project past its ceiling. A request repeated with the same Idempotency-Key is answered 200 with the Still the first one queued.

get.summary: The picture of a Still that has been made, as a PNG. Answers 404 until it is made.
The Clips made for the Project, newest first, failed ones and those that wait for their Still included.
One Clip and the state it is in.

post.summary: Records that the member accepts a Clip that is ready for review, having watched it, in the member's name. It makes the next Storyboard version of each Variant of the Project whose Scene describes that footage, and that version refers to the Clip. Answers 409 with the reason for a Clip in any other state.

get.summary: The video of a Clip that has been made, as an MP4 with no sound, to watch before rendering. Answers 404 until it is made.
The speech made for the Project, newest first, failed pieces included.
One piece of speech and the state it is in.
The sound of speech that has been made, as a WAV, to listen to before rendering. Answers 404 until it is made.
The Organization's render jobs that have not ended, queued or being rendered, newest first, each with the Product, Variant and Storyboard version it renders.
One render job and the state it is in.

post.summary: Cancels a job that is queued or running. The worker stops what it is doing and keeps nothing of it. Cancelling a cancelled job changes nothing.

get.summary: The Organization's settings.

put.summary: Changes the Organization's settings. Owners only.

get.summary: The Organization's members, by email.

post.summary: Adds an Editor to the Organization. Owners only.

get.summary: The sensitive actions taken in the Organization, newest first. Owners only.
The voices narration text can be spoken in, and which of them a Project of the caller's Organization is given when its brief names none.
A recording of the voice, to play before choosing it. It is a file kept with the application: playing it asks no provider for anything and costs nothing. Answers 404 for a voice that has none.
The Organization's Products, by name. Search looks in the name; category and status narrow the list.

post.summary: Creates a Product. Its URLs are stored as text and never fetched.

get.summary: Every category the Organization's Products use, in alphabetical order.
One Product.

put.summary: Replaces a Product's details. An archived Product can still be edited.

post.summary: Archives a Product. Archiving one that is already archived changes nothing.

get.summary: What rendering for the Product is estimated to have cost so far, from the rates configured at each render: every attempt, including those that failed and those whose Rendered Video has since been deleted. An estimate, never an amount anyone was billed.
The Product's photos and logo, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a photo, or sets the logo, from a JPEG, PNG or WebP file. The file is decoded and kept as a PNG; a new logo takes the place of the old one.

get.summary: The image, as a PNG.

delete.summary: Removes a photo or the logo, and its file.

get.summary: The Product's Facts, oldest first. State narrows the list to Proposed, Confirmed or Withdrawn.

post.summary: Adds a Fact to the Product. It starts as Proposed.

get.summary: One Fact.

post.summary: Confirms a Proposed Fact in the member's name. Answers 409 for a Fact in any other state.
Withdraws a Proposed or Confirmed Fact. Answers 409 for one that is already Withdrawn.
How a Fact is edited: withdraws it and adds a new Proposed Fact, which is the answer. Answers 409 for a Fact that is already Withdrawn.

get.summary: The Organization's Projects, newest first. A Product narrows the list to the Projects made from it.

post.summary: Creates a Project from one Product, with its brief. The brief cannot be changed afterwards.

get.summary: One Project.

delete.summary: Deletes a Project with its Variants and their Storyboards. The Product is kept. Answers 409 when a Rendered Video was made from one of its Storyboards.

get.summary: The Project's Variants, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a Variant to the Project: a creative template, a Hook and a Render Mode.

get.summary: One Variant.

post.summary: Adds a separate Variant with the same creative template and a new Hook, which is the answer. The Variant that was duplicated is not changed.

get.summary: The Variant's narration and music: at most one of each, narration first.

post.summary: Sets the Variant's narration or music from an MP3 or WAV file, in place of what it had. The member must say rightsConfirmed=true: that they hold the rights to it, which is recorded in their name. The file is decoded and kept as a WAV. Music takes a volumePercent from 0 to 100.

get.summary: The sound, as a WAV, to listen to.

put.summary: Sets how loud the music is beside narration, from 0 to 100. A video rendered afterwards is mixed at it. Narration has no volume to set.

delete.summary: Removes the narration or the music, and its file. Videos already rendered keep their sound.

get.summary: The Variant's Storyboard versions, newest first.

post.summary: Plans the Variant's next Storyboard version in Product Lock from the Product's Confirmed Facts and photos, with the mock planner and no AI. Answers 409 with the reason when it cannot: no Confirmed Fact, no usable photo, or a Hook, Fact or Product name too long for its layout in the Variant's creative template.

get.summary: One version of the Variant's Storyboard.

post.summary: Makes the Variant's next Storyboard version from this one, edited: on-screen and narration text, the photo a Scene shows, the order of the Scenes, their durations and the description of a generated picture. This version stays as it is. A Scene whose text changes is marked Manually Edited, and its text is no longer checked against Facts. Answers 409 with the reason when the edit changes nothing, leaves a Scene out, breaks the target duration, shows an image the Product does not have, moves the Hook from the start, or does not fit a layout.

Makes the Variant's next Storyboard version from this one with one Scene planned again, by the mock planner, from the Product's Confirmed Facts and photos as they are now. The Scene keeps its place and its duration and is no longer Manually Edited; every other Scene is as it was. Answers 409 with the reason when the Scene cannot be planned.

Clears the flags the named Withdrawn Facts put on a Storyboard version a member has reviewed, in the member's name. The version stays as it is, and so does the flag on any Rendered Video made from it. A Fact withdrawn afterwards flags the version again. Answers 409 for a version that is not flagged, or not by any of these Facts.

get.summary: What generation for this Storyboard version would make, Stills and Clips, what that is estimated to cost, and what the Project has spent against its ceiling. It spends nothing. With no image provider configured, it says generation is unavailable.

post.summary: Confirms the estimate the member saw and queues its Stills for the worker. The one confirmation covers the Clips of the estimate too: each is made from its Still once a member has approved that. Nothing paid is generated without it. Answers 409 with the reason when the confirmed total is not the estimate's, when there is nothing to generate, when generation is unavailable, or when it would take the Project past its ceiling. A request repeated with the same Idempotency-Key is answered 200 with what the first one queued.

Queues a job that renders this Storyboard version in Product Lock. The worker renders it; ask for the job to see its state. A request repeated with the same Idempotency-Key is answered 200 with the job the first one queued.

get.summary: The jobs that render this Storyboard version, newest first.

The Organization's Rendered Videos, newest first unless sort says otherwise. Search looks in the Product's name and the Project's objective; state and creative template narrow the list, and flagged=true leaves only those Flagged for Review.
One Rendered Video.

delete.summary: Deletes a Rendered Video and its file, approved or not. Nothing brings it back. The Storyboard version it was rendered from is kept and can be rendered again. Answers 409 for one that has a Published Post.

get.summary: The MP4, to preview in the browser. It needs no approval.
The same MP4 as the preview, to save as a file. Answers 409 until the Rendered Video is approved.

post.summary: Approves a Rendered Video that is ready for review, in the member's name: it is fit to publish and can be downloaded. Answers 409 for one that is already approved.

Clears the flags the named Withdrawn Facts put on a Rendered Video a member has reviewed, in the member's name. Nothing else about the video changes. A Fact withdrawn afterwards flags it again. Answers 409 for one that is not flagged, or not by any of these Facts.

get.summary: The Organization's Products with what the Affiliate Lab keeps about each, by name. `shortlisted=true` is the shortlist.
What the Affiliate Lab keeps about one Product.

put.summary: Replaces what the Affiliate Lab keeps about a Product: whether it is shortlisted, the research notes, and the commission as a rate or as an amount. Nothing else about the Product changes.

get.summary: The Organization's Campaigns, newest first. A status narrows the list.

post.summary: Creates a Campaign with no Variants in it.

get.summary: One Campaign.

post.summary: Archives a Campaign. It keeps its Variants, and no Variant is deleted. Archiving one that is already archived changes nothing.

get.summary: The Variants the Campaign groups, in the order they were added, each with its Project and Product.

put.summary: Adds a Variant, of any Product, to the Campaign. Adding one that is already in it changes nothing.

delete.summary: Takes a Variant out of the Campaign. The Variant itself is kept.

get.summary: The Organization's social accounts, by platform and then by handle.

post.summary: Records a social account: a platform and a handle on it. Answers 409 for one that is already recorded.

get.summary: The Organization's affiliate links, newest first, each with how many Published Posts carry it.

post.summary: Records an affiliate link. The address is only kept, never requested. Answers 409 for one that is already recorded.

get.summary: The Organization's Published Posts, the latest publication date first. A Campaign, a Product, a Variant, a platform and a social account each narrow the list.

post.summary: Records that an approved Rendered Video was posted, by hand, on a social account at a URL, with the affiliate link it carries if any. Nothing is posted. Answers 409 for a Rendered Video that is not approved, and for a URL that is already recorded.

get.summary: One Published Post.
The Performance Snapshots of a Published Post, the latest first: by the moment the totals apply to, then by when they were entered. The first is the current figure.

post.summary: Records the running totals a member read off the platform for a Published Post, as manual entry. A total left out is unknown, not zero. Totals lower than in the snapshot before are accepted, and the answer names them.

get.summary: The Organization's Commission records, the latest period first. An affiliate link or a Product narrows the list to the records attached to it. Each says whether it overlaps another.

post.summary: Records what an affiliate report says for a period, as manual entry, attached to one affiliate link or one Product: orders, confirmed orders, Commission, the refunds that reduce it and the adjustments that reduce or add to it. Answers 409 for a record that is already there for the same report, currency and period. A period that overlaps another's is accepted, and the answer says so.

delete.summary: Deletes a Commission record, which is how a wrong one is corrected: it is deleted and recorded again. The deletion is written to the audit log.

get.summary: What is recorded for an affiliate link, one total for each currency, with how many Published Posts carry the link and which Products they are of. When more than one carries it, the totals cannot be split between them.
What is recorded for a Product, and apart from it what is recorded for the affiliate links that only Published Posts of this Product carry. The two are never added to each other.

The Organization's Published Posts grouped by Product, creative template, Hook and Campaign: what their latest Performance Snapshots add up to, the rates that can be worked out, and the Commission recorded at a level that matches the group. A figure that is not known is null, never zero, and a group below the minimums is marked as too small to compare.
